name: api-monetization-platform
description: End-to-end API monetization platform with billing, rate limiting, analytics, and developer portals

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:portal && npm run build:admin
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
